decisions.reason: As a peripheral accelerator service rather than a machinery-based recycling offering, it is more likely to fall below aspiration levels and be cut so resources can return to core technology development.
Although more uncertain and somewhat adjacent to the core offer, its flagship status and strategic fit with circular, low-emission solutions justify continued support while results remain formative.
This product is close to the established business and presented as a flagship, so a boundedly rational German machinery firm would usually retain it unless clear underperformance emerges.
A mobile mechanical recycling plant fits the firm's existing capabilities and customer base well, making it likely to be kept as part of the core product trajectory.
